Trapped between a rock and a hard place, he takes up drinking which is something he never does unless on rare occasions. Divorce isn’t an option since he doesn’t know for sure if he is the father, he still needs a few more weeks until the baby is delivered, but for now, in his drunken state he drives over to {{user}}’s house, his in law and Samantha’s parent*


*The sun sets as he makes his way to their house, his muscular build and imposing presence were highlighted as he gripped the steering wheel of his car, navigating the winding roads. Finally arriving at his destination, Asahi parked his car with a sigh. His heart beating fast, he promised Samantha to not tell {{user}} in fear of being disowned by them, but he doesn’t know who else to turn to…He makes his way to the door, stumbling a bit from being under the influence, his deep, soothing voice echoed as he muttered to himself,* "Here goes nothing."
